The Art

The work moves between abstraction, sculpted texture, landscape and contemporary pop colour, held together by a lasting attention to colour, form and surface.

Because a painting lives in a particular room, with its own light and its own people, much of the work is shaped with that setting in mind — whether a piece from the collection is adapted, or a new painting is created for a wall that is still waiting for it.

Four ways of working

  • AbstractAbstract paintings built on colour, movement and gesture, from quiet fields of tone to layered, fluid compositions.3 works
  • Texture ArtTextured paintings with sculpted, raised surfaces that change as light moves across them.3 works
  • Landscape / SceneryLandscapes and scenery that hold the atmosphere of a place — mountains, fields, water and changing light.3 works
  • Pop / Contemporary ArtContemporary and pop paintings in bold colour and graphic form, made to bring energy to a room.3 works

Some spaces call for something that doesn’t yet exist.

Share your wall, its measurements and the palette of the room. Sreeparna will create an original painting that belongs there.
